title: L¹ convergence to a constant from uniformly convergent mollifications and an L¹ mollification error bound
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, R > 0, c ∈ ℝ, φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ℝⁿ = Euclid n) continuous with compact support, u_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) Lebesgue integrable on B_{2R}(0), and a_k ∈ ℝ with a_k → 0. Put w_k(x) := ∫_{B_{2R}(0)} u_k(y)·φ(x − y) dy. Assume w_k → c uniformly on closedBall(0, R) and ∫_{B_R(0)} |u_k(x) − w_k(x)| dx ≤ a_k for all sufficiently large k. Then ∫_{B_R(0)} |u_k(x) − c| dx → 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R c : ℝ) (φ : Euclid n → ℝ) (u : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < R → Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → (∀ k, IntegrableOn (u k) (ball 0 (2 * R))) → TendstoUniformlyOn (fun k x => ∫ y in ball 0 (2 * R), u k y * φ (x - y)) (fun _ => c) atTop (closedBall 0 R) → Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∫ x in ball 0 R, |u k x - ∫ y in ball 0 (2 * R), u k y * φ (x - y)| ≤ a k) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x in ball 0 R, |u k x - c|) atTop (𝓝 0)
